subject: SyncChain: rotating slot proposal and next steps
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lopez <anna@novacorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -0400
Subject: SyncChain: rotating slot proposal and next steps

Hi Anna — great conversation earlier. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can lock the technical deep dive and pilot a rotating schedule that keeps coverage fair across your global teams.

Recap (2 min):
- We validated the use case: high-throughput conversational summaries + private deployments for PII-sensitive pipelines.
- Nova engineering wants a 60–90m technical deep dive involving infra + security (Tom + 2 engineers).
- Success criteria for pilot: < 150ms p95 token latency on 2k token windows, deterministic cost/budget guardrails.

Proposed next steps:
1) Tech deep dive — 90 minutes (recorded) to walk infra, run simple perf test, and align on rollout plan.
2) Pilot schedule — 3-week rotating window so that no single region carries the early/late calls every week.

Rotating schedule (example pilot pattern, Week A/B/C rotation):
- Week A (US morning): Mon/Wed 10:00–11:30 PT (US-friendly)
- Week B (EU morning): Tue/Thu 09:00–10:30 CET (EU-friendly)
- Week C (APAC morning): Wed/Fri 10:30–12:00 HKT/Singapore time (APAC-friendly)

We attached a CSV with suggested 3-week slots (novacorp_availability_rounds.csv) — if you prefer we can run a one-week trial first and then expand.

Can you confirm: 1) primary participants (Tom + names), 2) preferred week to start (A/B/C), and 3) any blackout dates next two weeks? Once you confirm, Ben will send a calendar invite with the first deep dive slot and the rotation cadence.

Thanks — I’ll block tentative slots next week until we finalize.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
--
Attachments: novacorp_availability_rounds.csv (CSV, 1 page), redwood-syncchain-playbook.pdf (PDF, 8 pages)
From: Anna Lopez <anna@novacorp.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@novacorp.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:18:00 +0100
Subject: Re: SyncChain: rotating slot proposal and next steps

Thanks Sean — that recap is perfect. Quick answers:
- Primary participants for the deep dive: Tom Nguyen (infra lead), Priya Shah (security), and Marcus Li (app eng). Tom is happy to join but asks that we avoid the week of July 5 (team offsites).
- Preferred start: Week B (EU morning) would be easiest for our central EMEA team to attend first; we can rotate after the first session.
- Blackouts: July 5–9 blocked, and Priya is out July 14–16.

Question: for the perf test, can your team bring a short sample dataset or should we provision a staging endpoint? We can provide a small anonymized payload before the call.

If you want, I can also open a calendar poll for the suggested Week B windows — I can cc the rest of the eng team.

Appreciate the clarity — looking forward to the deep dive.

—Anna
Head of Platform
NovaCorp

Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SyncChain: rotating slot proposal and next steps

Thanks Anna — Week B noted, and we’ll avoid July 5–9. For the perf test: we can accept either option. Two approaches we recommend (pick one):
- You provide a small anonymized payload (preferred) and we hit a staging endpoint you control, OR
- We bring a short synthetic sample and run it against our hosted demo endpoint; you can mirror it on your side later.

Ben — can you take point on scheduling the Week B slot? Anna prefers EMEA-friendly times; suggested windows in the CSV for Week B are Tue 09:00 CET and Thu 09:00 CET (90m). If either works, set the first deep dive for next Tue (6/30) 09:00 CET and we’ll label the meeting as Week B — we can rotate thereafter.

Ben — once you pick a slot, include the Zoom link and attach the test payload template (small JSON sample). I’ll also share the playbook PDF so the team has the agenda.

Sean
